# DevTools Forge

> A free suite of browser-based developer tools. Every tool runs locally in the
> browser, uploads no files, and needs no account.

## Tools
- [PDF Merge](https://devtools-forge.test/products/pdf-merge): combine several PDFs into one, in-browser.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://devtools-forge.test/docs/getting-started): how to use the tools.
